evals.name: fix-missing-section
evals.prompt: Fix src/pages/index.astro. The file is missing the testimonials section from the design brief. Design brief specifies sections: hero, features, testimonials. Current file only has hero and features. Add the missing testimonials section.
evals.expected_output: The file is updated to include the testimonials section in the correct position (after features). The section uses appropriate components (Card or similar) and layout.

assertions.name: section-position
assertions.check: Testimonials section appears after features section

evals.name: fix-interactive-component
evals.prompt: Fix src/components/Header.astro. The NavigationMenu component is not interactive - it needs a client directive. Add the appropriate client directive to make it work.
evals.expected_output: The NavigationMenu component now has 'client:load' or 'client:visible' directive. The menu should be interactive now.

assertions.name: directive-added
assertions.check: NavigationMenu component has client:load or client:visible

evals.name: fix-semantic-html
evals.prompt: Fix src/components/Header.astro. It uses <div class="header"> instead of semantic <header> tag. Also uses <div class="nav"> instead of <nav>. Convert to semantic HTML.
evals.expected_output: The file now uses <header> instead of div.header and <nav> instead of div.nav. Preserves all classes and functionality.

evals.name: fix-responsive-grid
evals.prompt: Fix src/pages/index.astro. The features grid is always 3 columns and breaks on mobile. Design brief specifies: '3 columns on desktop, 1 column on mobile'. Fix the responsive classes.
evals.expected_output: The features grid now uses responsive classes like 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3' or similar to handle mobile correctly.

assertions.name: responsive-classes
assertions.check: Grid has responsive breakpoint classes (md: or lg:)

assertions.name: mobile-grid
assertions.check: Grid is single column on mobile (grid-cols-1)
